title: Pivot & Conditional Aggregation
description: Master the CASE-WHEN-as-pivot pattern that BI dashboards and segment reports lean on: bucketing values into bands, cross-tab summaries by attribute, and pivot-style outputs without a native PIVOT operator.
outcomes: You'll fluently translate business-band requirements into CASE WHEN bucketing, build pivot-style cross-tab summaries when the engine has no native PIVOT, and combine conditional aggregation with joins to slice metrics by attribute.
